payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

check.question: Compared with the source image, has the mug been moved toward the right of the headphones, and is it now to their right?
check.complete_when: The edited image shows the mug to the right of the headphones, with evidence of the requested movement from the source arrangement.
check.partial_when: The mug has visibly moved toward the right relative to the headphones, but remains left of them or is not clearly to their right; or the edited image shows a rightward move but the final relation is ambiguous.
check.absent_when: The mug remains in its source position relative to the headphones, or has not moved toward their right.
check.unknown_when: The mug or headphones cannot be reliably identified in both images, or their relative movement cannot be determined.

dependencies.evidence: Both objects are identifiable in the edited image: the mug is on the right and the headphones are near the center, so their relative positions can be compared.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"In the source, the mug is left of the headphones. In the edited image, the mug is clearly to their right, showing the requested rightward relocation."}

parsed.evidence: In the source, the mug is left of the headphones. In the edited image, the mug is clearly to their right, showing the requested rightward relocation.
